title: Monte Carlo Random Walk Kernel
abstract: arXiv:2610.40956v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We introduce the Monte Carlo Random Walk Kernel (MCRWK), an estimator whose per-pair cost is independent of graph size and derived directly from the random walk kernel (RWK) expansion. By normalizing the kernel coefficients, MCRWK samples a shared walk length and estimates its contribution using random walks on the input graphs. This gives a simple way to approximate RWK without constructing the product graph. For a fixed expected walk length and efficient neighbor sampling, each pairwise estimate takes $O(m)$ time for $m$ Monte Carlo samples, allowing the sample budget to control the trade-off between runtime and accuracy. We evaluate MCRWK against Graph Voyagers and classical RWK methods on synthetic and real graph datasets. In the reported experiments on large synthetic graphs, MCRWK is faster than Graph Voyagers and, at matched runtime, more accurate. It also has the lowest Gram-matrix runtime on the five real datasets studied. Code

translated_abstract: 我们提出了蒙特卡洛随机游走核（MCRWK），这是一种每对代价与图规模无关的估计器，直接由随机游走核（RWK）展开式推导而来。通过归一化核系数，MCRWK采样一个共享的游走长度，并利用输入图上的随机游走来估计其贡献。这提供了一种无需构建乘积图即可近似RWK的简单方法。在固定的期望游走长度和高效的邻居采样下，每对估计在使用m个蒙特卡洛样本时仅需O(m)时间，从而使样本预算能够控制运行时间与精度之间的权衡。我们在合成和真实图数据集上，将MCRWK与Graph Voyagers以及经典RWK方法进行了对比评估。在大型合成图上的实验中，MCRWK比Graph Voyagers更快，且在相同运行时间下更准确。在所研究的五个真实数据集上，它还拥有最低的Gram矩阵运行时间。
tldr: 提出了蒙特卡洛随机游走核（MCRWK），一种每对计算成本与图规模无关的估计器，无需构建乘积图即可高效近似随机游走核，在运行时间和精度上均优于现有方法。
en_tdlr: Proposes the Monte Carlo Random Walk Kernel (MCRWK), an estimator with per-pair cost independent of graph size that approximates the random walk kernel without constructing the product graph, outperforming existing methods in both runtime and accuracy.
